### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **48** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **23** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/kernel.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/kernel.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3`.

⛔ **10** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **23** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/kernel.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/kernel.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `packageId (4 routes)`
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `29c55541b31c8ae769b2061064f6690b8d9b58d1` — the merge of head `d821656cf49e4e1ae8cdc5ec4512a51a2492dc37` into base `6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 29c55541b31c8ae769b2061064f6690b8d9b58d1 && git checkout 29c55541b31c8ae769b2061064f6690b8d9b58d1
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3 d821656cf49e4e1ae8cdc5ec4512a51a2492dc37 && git checkout -B drift-repro 6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3 && git merge --no-ff d821656cf49e4e1ae8cdc5ec4512a51a2492dc37

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

A removal from `packages/spec/src/**`, so a same-shape `## Contract review` PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on the landing head is owed. `needs:contract-review` is added in this stroke.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #25608`, title `feat(spec)!:`. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` and `Ruling-ref: 6259332195` are line-initial in the body and in the changeset (`@objectstack/spec` `minor` under the launch-window convention, with the BREAKING banner, FROM → TO, and `registered kernel-package-upgrade-family-retired`). 44 files, +642/−1374. `check-governed-merges --pr 25757`: NOT governed, 2016 lines (under 3000). The governed half (the ADR-0126 and ADR-0138 D5 sentences) is #25716, which os-zhuang merged at 2026-10-25T03:18:59Z. The body's "merges after this one" is stale on that point. Acceptance note, no carrier: the ADR text describes the retirement this PR makes.
2. **The ruling, measured on the diff.** Ruling A on #24443, item 3 (「**Retired:** `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts` … with its ADR-0087 conversion」), done directly in 18.x per triage `6382810541`:
   - **Removed:** the module and its test, and the `kernel/index.ts` re-export (a comment names the retirement in its place).
   - **Removed from `IPackageService`:** four members (`planUpgrade`, `upgrade`, and also `rollback` / `getSnapshot`, which returned retired types too), plus three input interfaces.
   - **Removed:** `plan` from the non-strict, unbound `PackageUpgradeResponse.data`.
   - **The card's lead was corrected by measurement:** four members and three interfaces, not two.
   - **The ADR-0087 record:** 10 `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` entries, which the manifest-deletion gate reads, plus one D3 semantic entry and one `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment. There is no D2 conversion and no tombstone, because no stack collection or metadata type carries these shapes. That is the export-job / change-management precedent, open question 1 A.
3. **Producers: 0, each beside a lit control.**
   - objectstack outside `packages/spec` (control: 17 hits inside it).
   - objectui `main` `a3c0da9` and its pin `2958f17e9c` (2123 / 2131 spec importers).
   - hotcrm `a4b3560` (293).
   - Nothing implements `IPackageService`.
4. **Gates.**
   - At `3e7b204be7` (with `origin/main` `c61f75d10f` merged; frozen install, full build):
     - spec `typecheck`: exit 0.
     - spec `test`: 21787 passed. The 23 failures are all `check-liveness.test.ts`, the main red #25751 fixes.
     - spec `test:repo`: 80 / 1279.
     - cli unit + integration: 501 / 6297.
     - The `(narrowing)` arm's dogfood battery: 295 files / 2520 tests, exit 0.
     - Derived families: 120/120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 118 exit 0. The 2 reds are main's (`check:liveness`, and `check:generated` through it).
   - At the pre-merge head: metadata-protocol 263 / 21485.
   - **Ablation:** the re-export put back. Predicted 3 red / 7 green, observed exactly that. Restored blob-identical.
   - Generated shards were regenerated, not hand-typed. The count pins follow the module: type-alias 790→786, file-description 31→30, llms.txt 206→205, quick-reference kernel 30→29.
5. **Open questions.**
   - (1) The ledger record in place of a D2 conversion. **A**: there is no authored document to rewrite.
   - (2) `PackageUpgradeRequestSchema` / `PackageUpgradeResponseSchema`. **A**: left as they are. The ruling names only `package-upgrade.zod.ts`. Recorded, no carrier.
6. **Deviations accepted.**
   - The claim's "conversion with its tombstone" wording assumed a carrier key that does not exist. The dev followed the measurement.
   - The scope widened only where the removal forced it.
   - No PR subscription, per the role file.
   - `mcp_calls` 4, all reads. Relay writes 3.
   - `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` was rewritten to say what is served (a re-install with `overwrite: true`, plus commit rollback).
7. **Landing.** Not governed. Two things block it:
   - **The liveness main red.** #25751 fixes it.
   - **The `plugin-pinyin-search` boot-reconcile timeout flake, #25749** (`domain:server`, p1, no fix PR yet). Every PR whose change reaches `packages/spec` misses the turbo cache and executes that test. #25751 failed it twice (`6394547054`).

   Once both are in `main`: the seat sends `pr_update_branch` through the relay, then the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review runs on that landing head. On PASS with every check green, the seat sends `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

Read-only: the diff with `git diff` against the pinned base sha, the head's files with `git show`, anonymous REST for the board, `scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs --pr 25757` for the gates. The dispatching seat's ACCEPT (`6394585108`) was read as one input and re-measured, not adopted.

### ① Derived judgments

**R1 — the removal takes what the ruling names, plus what it forced, and nothing else. Right.** `kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts` had 26 exports at the base (10 `*Schema` consts, 16 type aliases) and leaves whole; the `kernel/index.ts` re-export is replaced by a comment naming the retirement (the plugin-runtime precedent the retirement skill cites). Forced, each traced in the cited code: the four `IPackageService` members — `planUpgrade` and `upgrade` as the card said, and `rollback` / `getSnapshot` because they returned `RollbackPackageResponse` / `UpgradeSnapshot` — with their three input interfaces (`PlanUpgradeInput`, `ExecuteUpgradeInput`, `RollbackInput`, read by no other declaration); `PackageUpgradeResponse.data.plan`, which carried `UpgradePlanSchema`; the `M92` import and its four isomorphic pins in `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (790 → 786, the other six defs carried `XParsed` aliases and were never pinned there); the `file-description` level-1 opener count (31 → 30, one `# Package Upgrade Protocol`); `build-docs.ts` `SECTION_GROUPS`; and the `compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` must-survive control, whose `MetadataChangeType` lost its only reader with this module (`BreakingChangeSchema` from `kernel/plugin-versioning.zod.ts`, exported through `kernel/index.ts` at the head, is a sound replacement). The 29 names the PR counts = 26 + 3. Nothing outside the ruling's item 3 is touched: `PackageUpgradeRequestSchema` / `PackageUpgradeResponseSchema` stay published (right — see ③, open question 2).

**R2 — `plan` leaves a non-strict, unparsed object without a tombstone. Right, by the skill's own fork.** The retirement skill's route table has a row for exactly this: a shape nobody parses takes neither `retiredKey()` nor a guidance-map entry, because a prescription no one can receive is noise. Measured at the head: nothing outside `packages/spec` names `PackageUpgradeRequest`/`PackageUpgradeResponse` (only the changeset); the D3 entry `package-api-contracts-unmounted-entries-retired` already records both schemas as bound to no route; `authorable-surface/api.json` carries only the top-level rows `api/PackageUpgradeResponse:{data,error,meta,success}`, so `data.plan` was never a surface row and no `api/` shard moves. The new pin in `package-api.test.ts` asserts a stray `plan` is stripped beside a lit sibling control — the right pin for a route-3 removal.

**R3 — the ADR-0087 carrier is the ledger record, not a D2 conversion or a tombstone. Right.** None of the ten defs is a stack collection or a metadata type; the skill's §3 says a surface with no authored source to rewrite takes the D3 `semantic` entry alone, and the manifest-deletion gate in `build-schemas.ts` (#4725) requires one `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR` entry per deleted manifest key. The PR supplies exactly that: ten entry files named per `entries/README.md` (`18.kernel__X.ts`, `export const entry = 'kernel/X'`), the ten manifest keys deleted (`json-schema.manifest/kernel.json` −10, the exact set), one `SemanticMigration` with all five required fields (`surface` backtick-free as the upgrade guide needs, `reason` stating why D3 and not D2, `acceptanceCriteria` naming the TS2305/TS2339 compiler evidence), and one `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment inserted at its id's sort position (between `hook-body-…` and `list-view-…`) with `order: 109` = highest existing + 1, as the list's header prescribes. Same carrier as the export-job and change-management precedents in `entries/retired-defs/18.api__*` / `18.kernel__MetadataChangeOperation.ts`. The ruling's phrase "with its ADR-0087 conversion" is thereby executed as the record the ADR offers for this class; the merged ADR-0126 sentence (#25716) describes the same retirement and is consistent. The retained history — `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` `kernel/UpgradePlan:estimatedDuration` and D3 `kernel-package-lifecycle-durations-unit-in-key` — is untouched and pinned; right, a registration is never deleted.

**R4 — the generated artifacts move the way a whole-def retirement must. Right.** The skill's visibility table says a whole-def removal MUST move all four ratchets; it did, and nothing was added: `api-surface` −29/+0 (26 kernel + 3 contracts interfaces), `declaration-map` −20, `export-origins` −29, `authorable-surface/kernel.json` −48/+0 across the seven non-enum defs, `authorable-defaults` −8, `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` −2 entries with its header totals (245→243, 835→831), the reference page deleted and the kernel counts 30→29 / 161→151 followed through `references/index.mdx`, `kernel/index.mdx`, `meta.json`, `llms.txt` (206→205) and `quick-reference.mdx`. `authorable-surface.base.json` is rightly NOT touched: `build-schemas.ts` makes it the deletion gate's anchor, a mirror of an already-merged upstream commit that a PR must never rewrite — the card's listing it among the regenerate targets was wrong, and the dev did not follow it. The liveness ledger (`packages/spec/liveness/*.json`) carried no row for any retired def at the head, so there is no orphan row for the main-red below to hide. `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` (which carries `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:spec-changes`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`) are `success` on the head.

**R5 — producers are zero, re-measured here beside a lit control. Right, with one stale citation corrected.** In this repository at the head, outside `packages/spec` and CHANGELOGs: the changeset and the one ADR-0126 sentence (now history, rewritten by #25716); control: 27 files inside `packages/spec`. objectui `origin/main` `0063f22ce`: 0 (the three `.getSnapshot(` hits are `assistantBus.getSnapshot()` in `app-shell`, an unrelated store; control `@objectstack/spec`: 2133 files). objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pinned AT THIS HEAD, `b41ed7f68956`: 0 (control 2126). HotCRM `origin/main` `a7faf819`: 0 (control 294). No class implements `IPackageService`. The dev's and the seat's census name pin `2958f17e9c`, which was the pin at the dev's base `47af3dde42`; #25735 moved it to `b41ed7f6` before the dev merged `c61f75d10f`, and the merge was not followed by a re-measure. `2958f17e9c` is an ancestor of `b41ed7f6`, and the zero holds at the current pin, so no objectui fix or pin bump is owed; the stale sha survives only in the PR body, the dev report and the pin test's header comment (prose, not an assertion).

**R6 — the new pin is inside its declared radius. Right.** `package-upgrade-family-retirement.test.ts` is listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`; its walk over `packages`, `examples`, `skills`, `content`, `scripts` with the stated extension sets is covered by the `@objectstack/spec` globs in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and the `@objectstack/spec#test:repo` inputs in `turbo.json` (`packages/**/*.{ts,…,yml}`, `examples/**/*.{json,md,mdx,yaml,yml}`, `skills/**`, `content/**`, `scripts/**`). Its anti-vacuity probes (matcher positives and negatives, visited floor, surviving neighbours) are present.

**R7 — the hand-written prose made false by the diff was corrected truthfully. Right.** `upgrading.mdx` now says what the platform serves; both replacements it and the changeset prescribe exist at the head: a re-install with `overwrite: true` (`package-api.zod.ts`, body or `?overwrite=true`) and the ADR-0067 commit rollback `POST /packages/:id/rollback` with `commitId` (served in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, declared in `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` with `RollbackToPackageCommitResponseSchema`, SDK `packages.rollback`); the new link target `/docs/api/metadata-api#package-management` is a heading on that page. `Check Documentation Links` is `success`.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/25608-retire-package-upgrade.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': minor` with the `**BREAKING**` banner — right under the launch-window convention `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` enforces (breaking records as `minor` outside pre-mode; the body says so in words). `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is the right kind (ten defs and 48 authorable rows leave the surface, `plan` is removed) and demands at least `minor`. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the right declaration: `dispatch-gates.mjs` states that a card that only narrows a published surface is `Clause-②: no` with the `(narrowing)` arm — the card's draft `yes (narrowing)` was the wrong reading and the claim corrected it. Both declaration lines and `Ruling-ref: 6259332195` are line-initial in the PR body and in the changeset. FROM → TO table present with one row per removed group and the one-line fix (delete the imports; TS2305 / TS2339 find them); the out-of-repo population beyond objectui and HotCRM is declared NOT MEASURED, which is honest. Disposition marker: exactly one, `adr-0087: registered kernel-package-upgrade-family-retired` — `registered` requires the id to resolve at the head and to be new in this diff; both hold. Breaking signals read by the gate: banner, title `!`, the `(narrowing)` arm and `narrowed` — four of five, `major` correctly absent. PR title `feat(spec)!:` carries the `!`. `Check Changeset`: `success`.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `6394223748`, every flag and open question:

- **Deviation: worktree created from a primary checkout that already had the branch checked out (detached it first).** Process only; the committed diff is unaffected. Answered.
- **Deviation: no PR-activity subscription (role file).** Not a contract matter. Answered.
- **Deviation: `git worktree remove --force` on the dev's own throwaway probe tree.** Own tree, clean. Answered.
- **Deviation: "ADR-0087 conversion" executed as the ledger record, not a D2 conversion or tombstone.** Right — R3. Answered.
- **Deviation: scope widened where the removal forced it (`rollback`/`getSnapshot`, three inputs, compliance control, count pins).** Each widening traced to a forced dependency — R1. Answered.
- **Open question 1 (carrier for shapes no collection or metadata type carries): A, ledger record + D3, no D2.** A is right — R3; B would be a transform with no seam. Answered.
- **Open question 2 (retire `PackageUpgradeRequestSchema` / `PackageUpgradeResponseSchema` too?): A, leave for a separate card.** Right: ruling item 3 names only `package-upgrade.zod.ts`; the pair is already recorded as unmounted by the D3 `package-api-contracts-unmounted-entries-retired`, so no new false claim is left standing. Whether a card is filed is the dispatching seat's call; nothing in this diff turns on it. Answered, not escalated.
- **Out-of-scope (a): `check:liveness` main-red.** Confirmed by reading, not by the dev's word: `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json` at this head AND on `origin/main` cites `engine.ts#renderFlowTextSlot`, while `renderFlowTextSlot` is defined in `packages/services/service-automation/src/node-text-rendering.ts` (engine.ts only imports it); the advisory `Spec property liveness` check is `failure` on the head and equally on `main` at `c61f75d10f` and `5874d25302`. #25751 (the one-line pointer fix) is still OPEN. Escalated to the landing seat below.
